part2.question: A special day out that cost you little money / didn't cost you much

segments.v: I want to talk about a day out with my friends last spring. We didn't spend much money. We walked across Long Biên Bridge. It is an old bridge over the Red River. The view was very beautiful and we saw trains. Then we went to the riverbank under the bridge. There were many flowers and vegetables. We had a picnic with bánh mì we made at home. We took many photos. In the afternoon, we walked around the Old Quarter and drank iced tea. I spent only about thirty thousand đồng. I liked this day because it was cheap but very fun. We talked and laughed a lot. Now we do this every month.
